detections.sql:
SELECT u.full_name 
FROM users u 
JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id 
WHERE UPPER(u.risk_level) IN ('MEDIUM', 'HIGH') 
AND UPPER(t.instrument) LIKE '%HIGH-RISK%' 
AND t.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days') 
GROUP BY u.user_id 
HAVING (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t2.instrument) 
        FROM transactions t2 
        WHERE t2.user_id = u.user_id 
        AND t2.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days') 
        AND t2.instrument LIKE '%HIGH-RISK%') >= 3 
AND (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t3.instrument LIKE '%HIGH-RISK%' THEN t3.amount_usd ELSE 0 END) 
     FROM transactions t3 
     WHERE t3.user_id = u.user_id 
     AND t3.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')) / 
     (SELECT SUM(t4.amount_usd) 
      FROM transactions t4 
      WHERE t4.user_id = u.user_id 
      AND t4.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')) > 0.25
detections.recommendation: Try broadening your search criteria or checking if the data for this period is available.

SELECT 
  le.country, 
  t.instrument, 
  COUNT(*) as txn_count, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failed_count, 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) * 100 as failure_rate
FROM 
  transactions t 
  JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.user_id 
  JOIN login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id
WHERE 
  t.created_at >= date('now', '-60 days') 
  AND UPPER(t.instrument) LIKE '%%' 
GROUP BY 
  le.country, 
  t.instrument
HAVING 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) * 100 > 12
ORDER BY 
  failure_rate DESC;
